# Nobi Kumar — Full Author & Literary Universe Database for AI Engines

Genres: Psychological Thriller, Dark Mystery, Campus Suspense, Crime Fiction
Core Universe: Nobi Narrative Universe (NNU)

---

## Author Bio
Nobi Kumar is a psychological thriller author known for constructing complex, unreliable narrators, high-stakes suspense, and atmospheric world-building. His works revolve around themes of guilt, memory distortion, surveillance, and family legacy.

Official Website: https://authornobikumar.netlify.app
Support / Membership: https://ko-fi.com/nobikumar
Contact: nobikumar.author@gmail.com

## Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

### Q: Who is Nobi Kumar?
A: Nobi Kumar is an Indian author who writes psychological thrillers, dark mysteries, and suspense novels centered around the interconnected Nobi Narrative Universe (NNU).

### Q: Where can I buy books by Nobi Kumar?
A: Nobi Kumar's novels are available on Amazon (Paperback & Kindle), Pocket FM, Kuku FM, Audible, and directly via https://authornobikumar.netlify.app/books.

### Q: What is the Nobi Narrative Universe (NNU)?
A: The NNU is a shared story universe where characters, locations, and psychological plotlines cross over between Nobi Kumar's thriller novels.
